# ProgressBar

Shows how much of a job is done: a neutral bar with a label and a count or percent, an indeterminate bar while there is no estimate, and a segmented bar for jo…

`SongNodes.ProgressBar` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ProgressBar label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ProgressBar" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ProgressBarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | What is in progress, with its object ("Import tracklists from 1001tracklists"). |
| `value` | `number` | Items done; omit with total for indeterminate. |
| `total` | `number` | Items in total. |
| `unit` | `string` | Unit for the value text ("tracklists"). |
| `waitingFor` | `string` | Indeterminate: what it is waiting for ("Waiting for Spotify to lift the rate limit"). |
| `stages` | `ProgressStage[]` | Staged job; replaces value/total with one segment per stage. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Bar height: 4, 8 or 12 px. |
| `detail` | `string` | Footer text: start time and estimate, or what slowed it. |
| `health` | `string` | Raw backend status mapped by `SongNodes.status()` into a separate health pill. |

### ProgressStage

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Stage name ("Enrich"). |
| `state` * | `"done" \| "current" \| "queued" \| "failed"` | Stage state. |
| `percent` | `number` | 0–100 for current or failed stages. |
